query:
-- Find races where both candidates have same party (likely data errors)
SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races 
WHERE candidate1_party IS NOT NULL 
  AND candidate2_party IS NOT NULL 
  AND candidate1_party = candidate2_party
ORDER BY state_code, CAST(district AS UNSIGNED);
